title: Reasoning map: core profile
description: Boxes, a breakdown, and arrows. Enough on its own: a map with only these fields is complete. Other profiles only add fields, and a reader that does not know a field ignores it. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (references resolve, no parent cycles, the first node is the root) are in protocol/README.md.

id.description: Short, stable identifier for the map.

core.description: The central claim of the map in one or two sentences.

profiles.description: Which profiles the map uses. core is implied.

parent.description: The box this one sits inside. Omitted: it sits under the root (the first node).

kind.description: A rendering hint only: claim, group, part, driver, mechanism, condition, outcome, failure, demoted. Unknown kinds draw as a plain box.

ref.description: Where this comes from: a section of a source text, a URL.

type.description: A rendering hint only: failure (a path to failure), dampens (reduces its target), weak (a thin or speculative link).
